svg.aria-label: Three quantities of a Keplerian disc plotted against radius on logarithmic axes, each divided by its own value at the inner radius. The angular velocity falls steeply, the orbital speed falls gently, and the specific angular momentum rises. A shaded note marks that the rising curve is the one the Rayleigh criterion tests, so the disc is stable at every radius.
svg.text: The Rayleigh criterion tests d(ℓ²)/dR, and for a point mass that is GM at every radius.
Positive everywhere: the disc is stable, and a stable disc transports no angular momentum.
